items.title: Christopher "Happy" Goldston Interview, 1959-01-13
items.q: They had me, Amos was playing cornet, and we had Winnie's, Ellie on trombone, Charlie Moore.

ctx.x: Oh, yes, the two-lane band. The brass band. The brass band. Who was in the dance band with him when you played for dancers?
They had me, Amos was playing cornet, and we had Winnie's, Ellie on trombone, Charlie Moore.
